articles.title: Uniswap launches TJAR fee tool, but only fast searchers capture the hidden arbitrage profit
articles.text:
Quick Take
- Uniswap says Robinhood already receives Uniswap API fees in USDC and USDG through its TJAR converter.
- Outside searchers pay a fixed token amount for selected fee assets, seeking surplus after execution costs.
- Lower release thresholds can accelerate receipts but leave more value for searchers when large fee deposits arrive.
Uniswap outlined on Oct. 30 how its Token Jar (TJAR) fee converter lets outside traders buy accumulated fee tokens for a fixed payment.
Uniswap opened TJAR to other apps on Oct. 29, saying Robinhood already uses the system for fees collected through the Uniswap API across its supported chains and receives USDC and USDG.
Those stablecoin receipts come from traders known as searchers, who exchange the required payment for fee assets held in an on-chain Token Jar. The arrangement sends the chosen token to a configured destination while leaving searchers to assess whether the assets are worth taking.
A Token Jar holds incoming assets, while a Releaser contract specifies the payment token, amount, and destination. The app’s operator chooses those terms.
The developer documentation says a searcher pays the full release amount even when selecting only some assets, and receives the entire balance of each asset it names. Anything unselected remains in the jar, and the payment goes to the operator’s configured recipient.
The jar does not value its holdings, and no price oracle automatically adjusts the payment, so asset balances and market prices can change while that amount stays fixed.
Searchers have an incentive to act when the recoverable value exceeds the payment and execution costs. Competition can narrow that margin, but the mechanism does not guarantee a profit.
Robinhood’s stablecoin setup differs from Uniswap’s protocol-fee deployment, which uses UNI sent to a burn address. TJAR lets other operators choose their destination.
The documentation currently says TJAR’s optional protocol fee is unset, although the Uniswap DAO controls that parameter.
Uniswap's faster receipts have a trade-off
Uniswap’s Oct. 30 pricing explanation says a lower release threshold generally lets jars clear more frequently, shortening exposure to token-price movements. However, a large deposit can suddenly push the holdings well above the fixed payment.
Its hypothetical example starts with a jar holding $950 of assets and a release price of 1,000 USDC. A $500 fee deposit takes the holdings to $1,450 without changing that price, so the resulting gap can reward the searcher at the operator’s expense.
A higher threshold makes individual deposits less significant relative to the payment, but generally leaves assets waiting longer before conversion. The operator balances frequent receipts against price exposure and the surplus available to searchers.

articles.title: Binance Links $6.3B Hack to Engineer’s Compromised Laptop
articles.text:
Binance points to engineer’s hacked laptop in $6.3B breach
Binance said attackers may have used a compromised DevOps laptop to access internal infrastructure.
Update (Oct. 30 at 2:44 am UTC): This article has been updated to include Binance’s preliminary investigation into the security breach.
Binance said its initial investigation into the multi-billion crypto breach pointed to a compromised DevOps engineer’s laptop.
The exchange said on Friday that the laptop compromise may have allowed an attacker to access a service container and submit unauthorized withdrawal transactions. It said it had found no evidence of a wallet private-key leak, though its investigation remains ongoing.
Speaking to Cointelegraph on Thursday, Blockaid CEO Ido Ben-Natan said Blockaid’s preliminary assessment also pointed to “key misuse,” in which attackers tricked or compromised a signing system into authorizing malicious transactions without extracting the underlying private key
“It seems to be … a compromise of signing infrastructure. We don’t think a key was leaked,” he said.
Ben-Natan’s assessment drew on Blockaid’s experience with similar attacks and its observations of the onchain activity.
Binance estimates $6.3 billion impact, freezes about $3 billion
Binance has now put the estimated total impact at around $6.3 billion and said it had worked with blockchain partners to freeze about $3 billion in stolen assets onchain.
The exchange said it would cover all losses using its Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU) and company funds, adding that user funds were safe. It also pledged to publish an updated Proof of Reserves.
Binance temporarily suspended deposits and withdrawals while conducting security checks and said it had revoked the affected address authorization. It is working with law enforcement and blockchain intelligence partners to trace and recover funds.
The exchange said it would publish a detailed technical post-mortem once the investigation was complete and the facts fully verified.
Blockaid identifies malicious wallet delegation
In its onchain analysis published on X, Blockaid said the attacker bundled 50 EIP-7702 authorizations into a single transaction targeting Binance 14. One authorization reportedly matched the account’s required nonce, allowing it to be accepted.
EIP-7702 allows an account to delegate execution to smart-contract code. Blockaid said the affected account was delegated to an unverified sweeper contract that allowed a designated operator to drain tokens and Ether.
Related: Binance hack rattles crypto markets as BNB falls 7%, Bitcoin slides
Ben-Natan told Cointelegraph the operation could have involved multiple compromised devices and movement through the exchange’s network.
Before Binance’s latest update, Arkham CEO Miguel Morel told Cointelegraph there was insufficient information to determine whether the attack involved stolen keys or compromised infrastructure.
“From what we can tell, it appears the hack is still ongoing,” he said at the time.
North Korea, Bybit comparison
Asked whether the suspected signing manipulation resembled the February 2025 Bybit attack, Ben-Natan described the incidents as “very, very similar.”
In that case, Bybit’s published forensic update said attackers compromised a Safe developer’s credentials, accessed the wallet provider’s infrastructure and deceived signers into approving a malicious transaction.
Ben-Natan also said the activity resembled operations linked to North Korea, citing Blockaid’s familiarity with those attacks. He pointed to sophisticated onchain preparations but emphasized that the attribution remained unconfirmed.
Binance has not identified the attackers, saying it is working with law enforcement to establish their identities.
Magazine: Tampered Ledger reported in Singapore a month before news broke: Asia Express

articles.title: Binance hackers deploy never-seen-before laundering tactics to conceal $6.3 billion theft
articles.text:
Quick Take
- Chainalysis uncovered previously unseen laundering patterns as Binance hackers moved stolen assets through thousands of suspected automated transactions.
- Elliptic traced $786 million in stolen stablecoin conversions, with attackers accepting discounts of up to 26% to rapidly move funds.
- Investigators now face complex wallet loops and repeated transfers, while 18,270 stolen BTC remain spread across 19 addresses.
Hackers behind Binance's $6.3 billion breach are using previously unseen laundering tactics while rapidly converting stolen assets into other cryptocurrencies.
On Oct. 30, blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis said that investigators identified thousands of transactions executed within short periods, suggesting the attackers used automation to obscure the movement of stolen funds.
The discovery comes as Elliptic reported that the hackers had converted approximately $786 million in stolen stablecoins into Ethereum and Tron before asset freezes took effect, sometimes accepting significant losses to complete transactions quickly.
Binance hackers use automated wallet loops and aggressive token swaps
According to Chainalysis, the attackers have adopted unusual transaction patterns that repeatedly circulate stolen assets among interconnected cryptocurrency addresses.
The funds sometimes return to wallets involved earlier in the laundering sequence, creating complicated transaction histories.
The firm described these movements as “laundering patterns we have not seen before,” pointing to their speed and repetitive nature as evidence of suspected automation.
Investigators also identified a distinctive pattern on the Tron blockchain, where numerous wallets received exactly 1 TRX before accepting additional funds and forwarding them to other addresses.
The repeated sequence suggests that the attackers are using programmed instructions to coordinate movements across numerous wallets.
The approach could complicate blockchain investigations by creating thousands of overlapping transfers that analysts must review to trace the destination of stolen assets.
Binance hacker sold assets at a steep discount
Meanwhile, Elliptic's investigation revealed that the attackers have been aggressively exchanging stolen cryptocurrencies through decentralized trading platforms.
On Ethereum, the hackers converted approximately 434 million USDT into 160,451 ETH through Uniswap, 1inch, and market makers' request-for-quote systems.
The transactions were executed at prices 12% to 26% worse than prevailing market rates, suggesting the attackers prioritized rapid conversion over preserving the full value of the stolen assets.
The hackers also exchanged approximately 234 million USDT for 638 million TRX through SunSwap, while another $48 million in Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin was sold before further restrictions were imposed.
Elliptic identified additional sales involving approximately 150 other stolen tokens, which the attackers converted into ETH through decentralized exchanges.
The conversions let the attackers consolidate assets into native cryptocurrencies such as ETH and TRX, which token issuers cannot directly freeze.
However, a substantial portion of the stolen Bitcoin has followed a different route.
Elliptic found that the attackers divided 18,270 BTC across 19 addresses through a series of smaller transfers, with most addresses holding approximately 1,000 BTC each.
As of the firm's Oct. 30 assessment, none of those Bitcoin holdings had reached an identified exchange or other service.
Elliptic expects the attackers to eventually route more stolen assets through additional wallets, cross-chain bridges, mixers, and trading services before attempting to cash them out through over-the-counter brokers and cryptocurrency exchanges.

articles.title: Binance gives 48-hour withdrawal target while Bitcoin deposits remain open
articles.text:
Quick Take
- Trading can change Bitcoin exposure while a paused withdrawal route still prevents external transfers.
- Binance Japan confirms normal deposits, trading and fiat transfers; crypto withdrawals remain paused.
- Binance plans a reserve update after remediation; roughly $3 billion remains frozen pending recovery.
Binance withdrawals remain suspended while deposits operate normally, leaving Bitcoin holders able to send assets into its global platform without an available crypto withdrawal route out.
The exchange's Oct. 30 security update estimates the incident's total impact at around $6 billion. For a holder who wants Bitcoin in a personal wallet or on another venue, an exchange balance and a completed blockchain transfer are different outcomes.
Binance News reports an expectation that withdrawals will resume within 48 hours as the exchange overhauls the withdrawal service and related addresses. CryptoSlate's Oct. 30 report describes Binance's latest update as estimating resumption in 45 hours. These are reported restoration estimates; neither establishes a precise verified reopening time.
If the pause continues into the weekend, holders will face price changes while their outgoing transfer route remains closed. Their ability to respond depends on which services their own account can use.
Trading access while Binance withdrawals are paused
Binance Japan’s initial Oct. 30 notice showed how trading and transfer permissions could diverge. It said trading remained available while deposits and withdrawals of all crypto assets were temporarily suspended. The regional business reported no confirmed impact on its customer assets.
Where trading remains available, a customer may be able to sell Bitcoin or change the asset held in an exchange account. That changes market exposure; it does not, by itself, put assets into an external wallet.
Binance Japan subsequently reported normal crypto deposits, trading and fiat movements, while crypto withdrawals remained paused. The earlier notices had described a different position:
Global and Japan notices describe different deposit conditions. Binance's global update says deposits are normal; Japan's notice says its crypto deposits are suspended. Customers cannot apply one entity's announcement to the other or assume that an available trading screen establishes access to every product and transfer service.
In a later Oct. 30 update, Binance Japan said crypto deposits, trading, and fiat deposits and withdrawals were operating normally. Crypto withdrawals remained paused, with resumption expected within 48 hours. Those service confirmations apply to Binance Japan.
The 48-hour guidance is a restoration target during a security overhaul. It does not guarantee simultaneous reopening for every asset, network and account.
The pause in Binance withdrawals also constrains any arbitrage strategy that requires moving coins out of Binance. Arbitrage is the attempt to trade price differences between venues; a route that depends on a suspended withdrawal cannot be completed in the usual sequence.
Traders who already hold balances on more than one venue may have routes that do not require an immediate outgoing transfer from Binance.
Price risk and the tests for reopening
CryptoSlate’s Bitcoin market data displayed BTC at $77,077 when checked at 13:48 UTC on Oct. 30.
The US Bureau of Labor Statistics scheduled the third-quarter Employment Cost Index for 8:30 a.m. Eastern on Oct. 30, or 12:30 UTC. Its September release reported that civilian compensation costs rose 0.8% over the quarter, seasonally adjusted. The index measures changes in employer compensation costs, including wages, salaries and benefits.
Farside Investors’ completed Oct. 29 session shows $17 million in net Bitcoin ETF inflows. Its Oct. 30 row was still incomplete at review time.
Binance says approximately $3 billion in affected assets has been frozen on-chain through cooperation with blockchain partners. Frozen assets are not confirmed recovered funds or demonstrated customer withdrawal liquidity.
The exchange also promises to cover losses using its SAFU fund and company funds, and to publish an updated proof of reserves after remediation.
For service access, the practical evidence would be a completed customer withdrawal, a corresponding blockchain transaction and receipt at the destination. Repeated successful transfers, alongside a clear official description of restored services, would support a broader reopening claim.
The promised reserve update answers a separate question about disclosed asset backing.

articles.title: Coinbase's $719 million profit reveals a company caught between two crypto economies
articles.text:
Quick Take
- Coinbase reported a $719 million Q3 profit as its prediction-market business expanded and crypto investments increased.
- The exchange added 643 BTC and 2,370 ETH, while prediction markets crossed $200 million in annualized revenue despite weaker spot trading.
- Record USDC balances failed to prevent a 16.6% decline in revenue remaining after rewards, highlighting the cost of stablecoin growth.
Coinbase returned to a $719 million quarterly profit despite weaker crypto trading, buoyed by its investment gains in Bitcoin.
The exchange's third-quarter earnings, released Oct. 29, showed revenue of $1.216 billion, largely unchanged from the previous quarter but down 35% year over year. Crypto spot trading volume fell 8% to $134.5 billion, while transaction revenue declined 44% from a year earlier to $590 million.
Chief Financial Officer Alesia Haas said that Coinbase recorded its 15th consecutive quarter of positive adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, which reached $333 million, up 60% from the previous quarter.
Nevertheless, Coinbase reversed a $359 million second-quarter loss as its diversification strategy gained traction. Prediction markets surpassed $200 million in annualized revenue, while subscription and services contributed nearly half of net revenue.
The results also revealed growing costs associated with its USDC business and increased investments in Bitcoin and Ethereum.
Prediction markets emerge as Coinbase's fastest-growing business
Coinbase's prediction-market business has emerged as an increasingly important revenue source as sluggish cryptocurrency trading activity weighs on its traditional exchange operations.
According to its Q3 earnings presentation, prediction markets surpassed $200 million in annualized net revenue during the quarter, following an 82% compound quarterly growth rate since launch.
The company also reported a more than 60% increase in daily prediction-market traders compared with the previous quarter, making the product one of its fastest-growing businesses by revenue.
Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong described prediction markets as “one of the fastest-growing products in Coinbase history,” highlighting strong demand for cryptocurrency-related event contracts even during seasonally slower sports-betting periods.
The momentum is helping Coinbase diversify its transaction business beyond conventional spot trading.
Prediction markets and derivatives together accounted for approximately 25% of transaction revenue during the quarter, while customers trading event contracts also generated additional cryptocurrency spot trading activity.
These gains helped cushion declining crypto trading volumes. Coinbase's share of global crypto trading activity increased to 10.7% from 5.6% a year earlier, supported by growth across spot and derivatives products.
Meanwhile, subscription and services revenue increased 3% quarter over quarter to $570 million, representing 49% of net revenue.
Haas said the expansion was making Coinbase more resilient because prediction-market revenue was “less correlated to crypto volatility.”
The exchange plans to expand prediction-market engagement through additional event categories and product integrations while developing USDC-native clearing infrastructure to improve trading economics.
Haas said:
“We obtained CFTC approval for our own DCO to support predictions. And so what this means is we have the opportunity to own more of the stack. That means we can launch our own contracts, and we can also then earn better economics.”
Coinbase's record $22 billion USDC holdings conceal growing rewards costs
While prediction markets provided a new growth opportunity, Coinbase's established stablecoin business faced a different financial challenge.
The exchange reported a record $22 billion in average USDC balances across its products, a 49% year-over-year increase and about 30% of the stablecoin's average circulating supply.
However, Coinbase's Q3 filing showed that stablecoin revenue declined 5.4% to $306.9 million from a reclassified $324.5 million a year earlier.
At the same time, USDC rewards expenses increased 15.8% to $129.2 million from $111.6 million, reflecting the growing cost of attracting and retaining stablecoin holders.
Subtracting the disclosed rewards expense from stablecoin revenue leaves approximately $177.7 million, down from $213 million in the comparable quarter.
That represents a $35.3 million decline, or 16.6%, despite the substantial expansion in USDC balances. The calculation excludes other income and expenses associated with the stablecoin business.
The divergence reflects competing pressures on Coinbase's commercial arrangement with Circle, the issuer of USDC.
Coinbase's filing attributed an $84.6 million positive revenue contribution to higher average USDC balances, while lower interest rates created a $52.8 million drag on revenue.
Interest income generated by the reserves backing USDC remains an important component of the economics shared between Coinbase and Circle. Lower rates therefore reduce the revenue available even as more customers hold the stablecoin.
The exchange has also been paying increasingly substantial rewards to support adoption. Still, the firm is looking to attract more participants to the USDC ecosystem. Haas said:
“Circle and we both have a goal to grow overall USDC market cap and adoption. In some cases, we could partner together to bring on more participants into the USDC ecosystem. We could also work independently to partner with various parties and bring them as partners on our respective platforms.”
Coinbase increases Bitcoin and Ethereum investments as crypto prices lift profits
Beyond its expanding trading and stablecoin operations, Coinbase also increased its direct exposure to cryptocurrency markets during the quarter.
A comparison of its second-quarter and third-quarter filings shows that the exchange's Bitcoin holdings for investment increased by 643 BTC, from 17,311 BTC at the end of June to 17,954 BTC in September.
Its Ethereum investment holdings also increased by 2,370 ETH, rising from 150,279 ETH to 152,649 ETH over the same period.
Together with other digital assets, the company's cryptocurrency investment portfolio increased in fair value from $1.47 billion to approximately $2.22 billion, a 51.5% quarterly increase.
Much of that increase reflected higher cryptocurrency valuations, which also contributed significantly to Coinbase's reported profitability.
The exchange recognized approximately $715 million in gains on crypto assets held for investment during the quarter, helping drive its $719 million net profit after three consecutive quarterly losses.
However, adjusted net income, which excludes those investment gains and certain other items, stood at $78 million.
The distinction highlights Coinbase's continued financial exposure to cryptocurrency prices even as prediction markets, stablecoins and subscription services become more prominent sources of revenue.
In its filing, Coinbase estimated that a hypothetical 50% increase or decrease in cryptocurrency prices would change the fair value of its investment portfolio by approximately $1.1 billion, with the resulting gain or loss flowing through its earnings.

articles.title: Lagarde to leave ECB with Europe’s tokenized-finance blueprint still undecided
articles.text:
Quick Take
- Appia received 127 consultation responses and has a blueprint due in 2028.
- One network could pool liquidity; several could preserve competition but fragment cash and collateral.
- Pontes targets longer hours by mid-2027 and continuous operation in 2028.
Christine Lagarde will step down as European Central Bank president on Feb. 7, 2027, while the Eurosystem is still weighing how to organize the infrastructure for Europe’s tokenized financial markets through its Appia initiative.
The departure announcement on Oct. 29 comes a day after the Eurosystem published Appia consultation findings that expose a basic tension: concentrating settlement money on one network could make markets more efficient, but concentrating control could make them harder to enter.
Appia is the Eurosystem’s initiative to develop an integrated ecosystem for tokenized wholesale finance, where assets are issued or represented on distributed ledgers. Its new report summarizes 127 responses and leaves the architecture open ahead of a blueprint due by 2028. The findings describe stakeholder views; the Eurosystem has expressed no architecture preference in the report.
Appia’s liquidity pooling meets the access test
Settlement infrastructure determines how buyers pay for assets and how transactions are completed. Appia’s architecture question is where central bank money should be available within a market built across different distributed ledger technology, or DLT, platforms.
Respondents identified advantages to putting settlement on a single network. Concentrated liquidity, common processes and simpler coordination could reduce fragmentation and duplicated investment.
The same arrangement could also concentrate activity in infrastructure with systemic importance. Respondents warned about dependence on a particular technology or vendor and weaker incentives to innovate. Pooling money would therefore solve only part of the integration problem if participants became locked into the platform that held it.
Multiple networks offer a different balance. They can accommodate different business models and reduce dependence on one infrastructure. For a bank, however, competition between platforms could still leave liquidity fragmented if its money or collateral cannot move efficiently between them. Without enforceable interoperability standards, respondents warned, separate networks could divide liquidity, collateral, identity and compliance into new silos.
A third configuration would make central bank money available on a limited number of eligible networks, operating under transparent admission criteria and common standards. Many respondents proposed this configuration as a way to balance network choice with common requirements.
That option remains subject to a fundamental test. The report says the feasibility of providing central bank money settlement on more than one network, while preserving Eurosystem control over that money, still needs assessment. An eligible-network model is an option under study, rather than an announced right for operators to connect.
The consultation places access rules at the center of the competition question.
Respondents sought objective, non-discriminatory admission criteria and a clear separation between the shared network and the commercial services built on it. They generally considered client-facing issuance, trading, custody and wallets unsuitable for the shared utility, because those are activities in which providers should compete.
For a DLT operator, that distinction affects whether it supplies common infrastructure, sells services to users, or attempts to do both. The concern is that an operator competing with its own users could undermine the neutrality of the infrastructure they depend on.
The report’s account of respondent views gives greater weight to central bank control, neutrality and open access than to ownership alone. A Eurosystem-operated network and market-operated networks bring different trade-offs; either would need rules that preserve the public authority’s control over central bank money and prevent discriminatory access.
The International Capital Market Association’s April position illustrates the preference for competition at the infrastructure level. It generally favors multiple interoperable networks under harmonized standards over a single Eurosystem-operated network, citing competition, concentration risk and market-led innovation.
That submission reflects a subset of ICMA’s DLT Bonds Working Group and predates the October findings.
Banks need movable cash and collateral
For banks, the practical issue is whether settlement balances and collateral can be used efficiently across venues. A common network could concentrate those resources. A competitive network system would need reliable movement between platforms to avoid leaving usable money or assets stranded in separate pools.
The report highlights central bank involvement in liquidity routing and collateral mobilization. Those functions make interoperability an operational requirement, rather than simply an agreement that different technologies should coexist.
Euro stablecoin issuers face a related question about the role of private settlement assets. Respondents viewed tokenized deposits and euro-denominated stablecoins as potentially complementary to central bank money within a two-tier system. That creates a possible place for different payment instruments without making each instrument equivalent to central bank money.
Existing collateral policy is narrower than a general opening to on-chain assets. In his Oct. 29 speech, ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone said the Eurosystem has accepted marketable assets issued in central securities depositories using DLT since March 30. Whether assets outside currently eligible settlement systems can qualify, and under what criteria, remains under assessment.
Some of the infrastructure is already operating. Pontes launched on Sept. 21 with initial core services and gradual onboarding. It connects market DLT platforms with the Eurosystem’s TARGET Services so wholesale tokenized asset transactions can settle in central bank money.
Cipollone set out the next delivery targets on Oct. 29: significantly longer operating hours by mid-2027 and 24/7/365 availability in 2028. Immediate settlement finality on the Eurosystem DLT platform is planned as early as 2027.
Appia’s 2028 objective is different: a blueprint containing findings, recommendations and principles for the wider ecosystem. Cipollone also said T2S, the existing securities settlement platform, would continue alongside new tokenized infrastructures.
A leadership handover, with architecture still open
Lagarde’s successor will enter that delivery timetable without acquiring sole authority over the design. Under Article 283, the European Council appoints the ECB president by qualified majority on a Council recommendation, after consultation with the European Parliament and the ECB Governing Council. The departure release names no successor.
The Governing Council remains the ECB’s main decision-making body, bringing together the Executive Board and euro-area national central bank governors.
The next concrete signals will come from design work and the terms of market participation. The consultation report envisages more complex cross-cutting testing in 2027 and a forthcoming stakeholder call covering tokenized deposits and payments, securities and shared network governance. Participation arrangements are still to be communicated.
For banks, issuers and DLT operators, the eventual access rules will help show whether Europe’s common settlement anchor can support competing businesses without fragmenting the money and collateral they need to operate.

articles.title: BOJ will more than double stock-fund sales from January
articles.text:
Quick Take
- The new pace is ¥860 billion a year at book value, or about ¥2,460 billion at indicative market value.
- The new pace targets about 0.1% of trading, while the BOJ retains discretion to adjust or suspend sales.
- Bitcoin could be affected if equity volatility triggers margin calls and cuts to leveraged portfolios.
The Bank of Japan will more than double its annual ETF sales following an Oct. 30 decision, increasing the stock-fund supply private investors will absorb from January 2027. Planned disposals rise from about ¥330 billion to ¥860 billion a year at book value.
Bitcoin‘s exposure is indirect: stress in equities could spread through leveraged portfolios.
The funds hold Japanese equities, rather than Bitcoin. The BOJ puts the new annual pace at about ¥2,460 billion at indicative market value. That conversion uses the market-to-book ratio of ETFs it sold during January through September 2026. Sales will be spread over the year, with the accelerated pace starting in January 2027.
The new pace targets about 0.1% of trading, calibrated using January-September 2026 Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market data. The earlier setting targeted about 0.05% of market trading at the time of the September 2025 decision. The two trading shares use different reference periods.
The BOJ's disposal framework allows it to temporarily adjust or suspend sales as financial-market conditions change. The bank says disposals since January 2026 have proceeded smoothly while avoiding a major market impact, alongside expanding stock-market trading.
The change concerns equity supply, while the overnight call-rate guideline stays around 1.25%, the target established in the September decision and effective Sept. 24. The ETF announcement therefore does not add a fresh policy-rate increase to yen borrowing costs.
How faster ETF sales could affect Bitcoin
The Bank for International Settlements' September 2024 review offers a historical example of how stress can travel. It describes August 2024 turbulence in which yen appreciation, carry-trade unwinding and equity volatility coincided with broader deleveraging and margin calls, including in crypto. Carry trades use borrowing in lower-rate currencies to finance higher-yielding positions.
If equity volatility rises, leveraged investors facing portfolio limits or demands for more collateral could reduce holdings across assets, potentially reaching Bitcoin.
January's implementation will test how comfortably the market absorbs the faster ETF sales.

articles.title: Do Prediction Markets Deliver Real Utility? | CoinGecko
articles.text:
Key Takeaways
- Driven by real financial ‘skin in the game’, prediction markets dynamically update in real time to provide precise probability distributions that continuously match or exceed the accuracy of traditional polls, expert surveys, and economic forecasts.
- Prediction markets have evolved beyond sports and election forecasting into crucial macroeconomic and geopolitical data infrastructure, widely adopted by major financial media, central bank researchers, and institutional market platforms.
- To establish prediction market data as trusted decision-making infrastructure worldwide, platforms must deepen liquidity to resist manipulation, actively engage regulators to reframe markets as monitoring tools, and maintain open, transparent data backed by independent research.
1. From Betting to Valuable Data
The first report covered the definition of prediction markets and how they work, and the second report covered the major regulatory developments. The central point of both reports is that prediction markets serve as valuable data, not merely as a venue for betting.
Major financial media and market infrastructure providers have begun to adopt prediction market data, which shows the value of that data.
Google Finance, CNBC, CNN, and The Wall Street Journal (WSJ) have started displaying prediction market probabilities, and Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange, and Tradeweb, an electronic trading platform for bonds and other assets, now distribute prediction market data to institutional clients alongside their existing market data.
A Federal Reserve Board working paper has also described prediction market data as a benchmark for macroeconomic expectations, such as interest rate decisions, inflation, unemployment, and GDP growth.
A Federal Reserve Board economist and co-authors described the markets of Kalshi, a prediction market, as “a high-frequency, continuously updated, distributionally rich benchmark that is valuable to both researchers and policymakers” (Diercks, Katz and Wright, 2026). Prediction markets are thus starting to be seen as a data source rather than a betting site.
Industry has already recognized prediction market data as valuable and put it to use. This final report in the prediction market series examines the utility of that data through three questions:
- How does a prediction market price become valuable data?
- Where is prediction market data used?
- Do today’s prediction markets produce that kind of data?
2. How Does a Prediction Market Price Become Valuable Data?
As covered in the first report, the core mechanism of a prediction market, the binary contract, normally pays out either $1 or $0 depending on whether a specific event occurs. For example, if a contract stating “It will rain tomorrow” trades at $0.62, market participants are estimating the probability of that event at 62%.
A prediction market price ($0.62) therefore works as an intuitive probability (62%) for a future event. Four structural characteristics explain why these prices count as valuable data that global financial institutions and media use in actual decisions, not as mere betting odds.
2.1. Credibility Through Skin in the Game
Some regard betting on prediction markets as plain gambling, but putting money at stake gives participants real ‘skin in the game.’
‘Skin in the game’ means bearing the risk and responsibility of one’s own decisions. Unlike an opinion that costs nothing to state, a wrong prediction costs participants their own money, so they build only carefully verified information and genuine beliefs into the price.
When many predictions with money at stake are aggregated, the prediction market price becomes highly reliable probability data, provided the market has sufficient liquidity.
2.2. Timeliness Through Continuous Real-Time Updates
Traditional polls and expert surveys provide only a snapshot from the time they were conducted, so they are slow to capture fast-moving changes. For example, if a sudden external economic shock or an emergency statement arrives today, ahead of a central bank rate decision due tomorrow, a poll finished several days ago or a monthly expert survey cannot reflect it at all.
Prediction market prices, by contrast, change the moment new information enters the market. Prices update continuously because participants readjust their positions whenever news, unexpected developments, or regulatory announcements arrive.
A prediction market price is therefore not a probability fixed in the past but timely data that reflects changes as they happen.
2.3. Probability Distributions Across Outcomes
Traditional indicators that center on a single average or peak value lose information because they compress many opinions into one number. For example, when forecasting a central bank rate cut, a typical expert survey shows only one average figure, such as a “0.25 percentage point cut,” and cannot show scenarios that depend on how committee members’ remarks shift.
Prediction markets, by contrast, produce a ‘probability distribution’ across every possible outcome. A probability distribution here shows the probability of every possible scenario together rather than a single outcome (for example, hold 20%, 0.25 percentage point cut 70%, 0.5 percentage point cut 10%). It is also a continuous time series.
This lets a prediction market measure not only the most likely central value but also tail risk, meaning outcomes that are unlikely but would have a very large impact if they occurred. Prediction markets therefore provide more than a single-point figure: their probability distributions support an overall assessment of future market volatility and potential risk.
2.4. Objectivity Through Verification After the Fact
Prediction market data earns trust in academia and global financial markets above all because its results can be fully verified after the fact.
Ordinary expert forecasts and surveys can also be checked for accuracy once the outcome is known, but the assessment usually leaves much room for interpretation, and institutions tend to cite only the track record that favors them. Prediction market data, by contrast, is recorded in full as a clear quantitative price (probability) and usually settles at 0 or 1 at expiry. Scoring is therefore mathematically exact and leaves no room for subjective interpretation.
Anyone can compare historical price data with actual outcomes transparently and without error. Because no one can manipulate this objective track record and it can be shown at any time, prediction market prices are more than subjective guesses: data professionals and institutions can rigorously judge their past accuracy, which gives the most reliable basis for adopting them as a core decision-making indicator.
3. Where Is Prediction Market Data Used?
Prediction market data has drawn public attention only recently, but its history goes back to the Iowa Electronic Markets (IEM) of the 1980s. For a long time its best-known use was forecasting elections, and its value has become more evident as prediction markets have recently been applied to a much wider range of areas.
3.1. Elections: Earlier and More Accurate Than Polls
The first case to show the potential of prediction markets was the Iowa Electronic Markets (IEM) described earlier. The IEM was compared against 964 poll results across five US presidential elections held from 1988 to 2004, and in 74% of cases it predicted the actual election result more accurately than the polls (Berg, Nelson and Rietz, 2008).
This advantage was not limited to the period just before elections. An analysis of the 1988 to 2000 presidential elections found that one week before the election, the IEM’s vote share forecast error (the gap from the actual vote share) averaged 1.5 percentage points, smaller than the 2.1 percentage point error of Gallup’s final poll, and even 150 days before the election the average error was only about 5 percentage points (Arrow et al., 2008).
The two figures cannot be compared directly, however. A poll is a current indicator that asks “if the vote were held today,” whereas a prediction market price is a forward-looking indicator of “the final result on election day.”
In fact, one study found that polls adjusted for the time remaining until the election were more accurate than prediction markets (Erikson and Wlezien, 2008). However, another analysis of the 2008 elections finds that when prediction market prices are corrected for their own known bias, they predict better than adjusted polls early in the campaign and in close races (Rothschild, 2009).
Prediction market prices are therefore more accurate than unadjusted polls and perform on par with highly calibrated polls. They also add value by providing forecasts that are updated every day from several months before an election.
3.2. Economy: Reading Macroeconomic Expectations in Real Time
For macroeconomic indicators such as interest rates, inflation, and employment, it is important to know accurately, before release, what the market expects.
Market expectations have traditionally been measured with expert surveys or the prices of traditional financial products. Surveys, however, are updated only every few weeks and so lack timeliness, while futures prices give a single figure, and option-implied distributions exist only for a few variables such as interest rates and headline inflation. Prediction markets, by contrast, produce a real-time probability distribution directly, through a price for each outcome.
This quantitative utility was already demonstrated between 2002 and 2005 in the economic derivatives market. An analysis of binary option trading data tied to the released values of indicators such as nonfarm payrolls, retail sales, and initial jobless claims found that market-implied forecasts were as accurate as, or more accurate than, the average expert survey, and the probability distributions implied by the market closely matched how often events actually occurred (Gürkaynak and Wolfers, 2006).
A recent Federal Reserve Board working paper (Diercks, Katz and Wright, 2026) evaluates prediction market forecasts against established benchmarks. The authors find that Kalshi’s median and mode forecasts for the federal funds rate had a perfect forecast record on the day before FOMC meetings and significantly outperformed fed funds futures at that horizon. Compared with the Bloomberg consensus, Kalshi forecasts were significantly more accurate for headline CPI inflation and statistically similar for core CPI inflation and unemployment. These findings suggest that prediction markets can improve on some benchmarks, while performing comparably to others.
The study also points to a broader range of practical applications beyond accuracy. Liquid derivatives-based indicators had not existed for key macro indicators such as GDP growth, core inflation, the unemployment rate, and nonfarm payrolls. Prediction markets remove this constraint by providing market-based expectations and detailed probability distributions in real time, which makes them a valuable benchmark for researchers and policymakers.
Prediction markets have been more accurate than traditional indicators for headline CPI and at least as accurate for interest rate decisions, and they also express macroeconomic expectations that traditional financial markets never covered as real-time probability distributions. This makes them a practical source of information.
3.3. Public Health: Flu Early Warning 2 to 4 Weeks Ahead
The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) publishes official flu statistics weekly, so there was a time lag in tracking how the flu was actually spreading.
To address this limitation, researchers at the University of Iowa ran a pilot prediction market for flu in which participating medical professionals traded. The market pooled the clinical information they provided voluntarily and predicted flu activity across Iowa two to four weeks in advance (Polgreen, Nelson, and Neumann, 2007).
Such forecasts may help inform treatment, prevention, and policy decisions. The case showed that prediction markets can support rapid response in public health. However, it was a pilot study confined to the state of Iowa.
3.4. Companies and Intelligence Agencies: Information That Bypasses Reporting Lines
In a typical company, negative news and uncertain outlooks tend to be diluted or played down as they move up the reporting chain. An internal prediction market, by contrast, has employees bet directly on whether internal matters such as revenue, new product launch dates, and hiring will succeed, and rewards correct predictions. This bypasses rigid reporting lines and quickly gathers candid frontline judgment and information into prices.
- HP: An internal sales prediction market traded by 20 to 26 active participants was more accurate than official management forecasts in 6 of the 8 comparable cases, and in all 8 it correctly identified the direction in which the official forecast was wrong (Chen and Plott, 2002).
- Intel: More than half of the 979 internal prediction markets operated from 2006 to 2013 were more accurate than the company’s official forecasts (Gillen, Plott and Shum, 2017).
- Ford: Based on trading in its internal features prediction market, the company said in 2011 that it had decided against including a Ford-branded bike carrier and an in-car vacuum in future models (Cowgill and Zitzewitz, 2015).
- Google: A senior executive told a company-wide meeting that a goal of filling a senior leadership role had been missed for six consecutive quarters and that the internal prediction market had seen this coming (Cowgill and Zitzewitz, 2015).
- Siemens: For a software project whose traditional project plan still showed the deadline as reachable, the internal prediction market warned of a delay of two to three weeks, and the project was in fact completed 13 days late (Ortner, 1998).
Prediction markets have also proved useful on national security and geopolitical questions. In a geopolitical forecasting tournament run by the US Intelligence Advanced Research Projects Activity (IARPA) from 2011 to 2015, researchers compared prediction markets with prediction polls (surveys of forecasters) over two seasons.
In forecasts of 261 events by more than 2,400 participants, prediction market prices were more accurate than the simple average of the poll responses in both seasons. They did not match team polls whose forecasts were weighted by past accuracy and statistically adjusted, but the result shows that prediction markets aggregate information well without further processing (Atanasov et al., 2017).
Inside companies, prediction markets have repeatedly been reported to capture information that official forecasts and reporting lines missed. In the intelligence tournament as well, prediction markets were more accurate than the simple average of poll responses. However, they did not match team polls whose forecasts were weighted by past accuracy, and some of the markets, such as those at HP and Siemens, had small trading populations of about 20 to 60 people, which is a limitation.
4. Do Today’s Prediction Markets Produce Valuable Data?
Do the prediction markets operating today also produce this kind of valuable data? To find out, we analyzed the market types and forecast accuracy using public API data from Limitless, an on-chain prediction market platform, as of October 2026.
4.1. Variety of Market Types
At the time of analysis, a total of 556 markets were open. Far from being limited to simple sports or entertainment events, they broadly cover policy and macroeconomic indicators as a whole, including interest rate decisions by major central banks, elections and geopolitical variables, and tech company IPOs and quarterly earnings.
Prediction markets, once confined to a few events, now cover macro indicators and policy variables across the board. This suggests that the utility verified in the earlier sections (accuracy, timeliness, and verifiability after the fact) is now extending beyond specific areas to the global economy and policy decisions generally.
Uncertainties and future volatility that traditional financial systems and polls struggled to capture are now quantified as reliable probability data, which market participants and policymakers can use as practical reference points for decisions.
4.2. Forecast Accuracy
To test how closely prices in these markets reflect the actual probability of events, we compared the price one day before the scheduled resolution time with the actual outcome in 2,681 resolved event markets from our collected sample (about 85% of them sports markets).
In 9 of the 10 price ranges, the gap between the actual outcome rate and the price was within 4 percentage points. For example, of 165 contracts priced at 70 to 80% one day before resolution, 74.5% actually came true, and of 113 contracts priced at 90% or above, 97.3% came true.
The only range with a notable error was 50 to 60% (actual occurrence rate of 48.8%), mainly because about a third of the contracts in this range, most of them sports markets, were still at their initial listing price of 50% one day before resolution.
Apart from these illiquid, less popular sports markets, prediction market prices reflect the actual probability of events with high precision.
4.3. Response to New Information
Timeliness is what supports this accuracy. To check whether prices reflect new information as soon as it arrives, we tracked the time series of prices on the Fed rate decision.
The Fed rate decision market adjusted its probabilities immediately whenever new economic data or policy variables were released. The probability of a rate hold, which stood at around 70% in mid-August, fell below 50% in late August and early September as major indicators were released,
dropped to about 20% right after the September 11 inflation data release, and then fell into the 10% range the day before the decision. The probability of a 0.25 percentage point increase, by contrast, rose to 86 to 89% on the day of the decision, almost the same as the roughly 90% probability implied by federal funds rate futures on CME FedWatch (Diercks, Katz and Wright, 2026; Daiwa Capital Markets, 2026). Limitless prices formed just before the decisions of other major central banks showed the same real-time responsiveness.
On-chain prediction market platforms operating today thus meet in practice the timeliness and accuracy that the earlier sections identified as core requirements of valuable data. These cases show that prediction market prices absorb incoming information in real time and continuously supply it as highly precise probability data.
5. Do Prediction Markets Deliver Real Utility?
As this report has shown, the essential value of prediction markets does not lie in speculative trading or profit. Long-accumulated academic research and the empirical analysis in this report show that prediction markets produce probability data whose accuracy and timeliness exceed or complement those of traditional surveys and expert forecasts in areas such as elections, macroeconomic indicators, and corporate outlooks. The move by global financial media and key market infrastructure to adopt prediction market data as a real-time indicator also rests on this practical utility.
In major Asian countries and elsewhere, prediction markets are still often viewed as gambling. This analysis shows, however, that prediction markets such as Limitless already list markets on major regional policy and economic issues, including the interest rate decisions of the Bank of Korea and the Bank of Japan, although trading in these markets is still thin.
For this data to become trusted decision-making infrastructure worldwide, including in Asia, three efforts are needed.
First, structural efforts are needed to reduce price distortion and eliminate market manipulation. Liquidity in markets for major macroeconomic and political events should be increased and the pool of healthy participants broadened, so that a small amount of capital or speculative actors cannot distort prices.
Second, active government relations (GR) and communication are needed to change policy perceptions of prediction markets. Policy authorities and regulators in major Asian countries should be engaged continuously, through a cooperative framework, so that they accept prediction markets not as targets of regulation or blocking but as a supplementary macroeconomic monitoring indicator that aggregates the collective knowledge of private participants.
Third, transparent data disclosure and an independent research community are needed. Accuracy metrics and time-series datasets should be published regularly and openly, and research by specialized analysts such as Limitless Research should be encouraged, so that research institutions, the media, and policy authorities can easily access the data and trust it on the basis of objective evidence.
Prediction market platforms are at a turning point, evolving from simple trading venues into next-generation data infrastructure. If real-time probability data that closely tracks policy and economic issues worldwide, including in Asia, can be supplied and verified transparently, it can serve as an objective and useful tool for decisions under future uncertainty.

articles.title: MEXC pulls out of four countries despite ambitious plan to rival global trading giants
articles.text:
Quick Take
- MEXC has withdrawn from four countries since September as its new CEO seeks to transform the 40 million-user exchange into a multi-asset trading platform.
- The retreat contrasts with an 81% surge in tokenized US stock trading and exploratory partnership discussions with Kraken's parent, Payward.
- MEXC's expansion ambitions face a major test as regulatory restrictions narrow its geographic reach and force customers to move assets elsewhere.
Crypto exchange MEXC is withdrawing from France, marking its fourth country-level retreat since September as its new chief executive pursues an ambitious global expansion.
The exchange said in an Oct. 28 notice that it would gradually discontinue services to French customers, automatically close outstanding trading positions by Jan. 22, 2027, and terminate withdrawals on March 5.
The decision extends a series of market exits under CEO Vugar Usi, who is seeking to transform the platform from a cryptocurrency exchange associated with memecoin speculation into a broader trading business offering tokenized equities, commodities and prediction markets.
MEXC began the latest withdrawals with the Netherlands on Sept. 29, citing regulatory developments in the European Economic Area. It subsequently announced the discontinuation of services to customers in Russia and Belarus on Oct. 20 as part of its global compliance efforts.
The retreat from France is particularly significant because the country's financial regulator, Autorité des Marchés Financiers (AMF), blacklisted MEXC in June 2024 for offering financial services without the required authorization.
The latest withdrawal also comes as Europe's Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA) imposes authorization requirements on cryptocurrency service providers, increasing the pressure on exchanges operating without the necessary regulatory approvals.
MEXC said French customers would face restrictions in four batches beginning Nov. 18, preventing them from opening new positions or making additional deposits once their assigned restrictions take effect.
Outstanding positions will be automatically settled on Jan. 22 based on prevailing market conditions and available liquidity, potentially exposing customers to losses or additional fees.
Any assets remaining after the March withdrawal deadline will be transferred to a regulated custodian, which the exchange has yet to identify.
Meanwhile, MEXC has begun offering affected French customers referrals to EU-regulated trading platforms, although users must independently open accounts and transfer their holdings before the withdrawal deadline.
MEXC's global ambitions face growing regulatory constraints
The market withdrawals contrast with Usi's strategy to expand MEXC's product offerings and establish the exchange as a retail-focused competitor across cryptocurrency and traditional financial markets.
Usi, who became CEO in April, has outlined plans to broaden the company's historically speculation-driven business into a platform that lets users trade multiple asset classes through a single interface.
The strategy builds on MEXC's approximately 40 million users, more than 90% of whom are retail customers, giving the exchange an established audience for new financial products.
Usi has also placed regulatory compliance and customer protection at the center of his leadership approach, emphasizing operational execution and the need to build trust among retail users.
The diversification strategy is already generating activity.
According to MEXC's September trading report, tokenized US stock spot trading volume increased 81% month over month, while trading in AI-related tokenized equities and ETFs rose 88%.
The exchange said it now offers more than 450 stock and index futures trading pairs and over 200 tokenized US equities, alongside its RealStocks service, which provides access to more than 7,000 US stocks and exchange-traded funds.
These offerings could help MEXC capture demand from retail traders seeking exposure beyond digital assets, although recent withdrawals have narrowed the number of jurisdictions where customers can access its services.
The company is also exploring external partnerships to strengthen its international business.
Earlier this month, MEXC disclosed discussions with Payward, the parent company of US cryptocurrency exchange Kraken, about a potential collaboration involving market access, trading infrastructure, and liquidity.
The companies identified complementary strengths, with MEXC emphasizing retail trading and access to crypto and traditional financial products, while Payward brings established financial infrastructure and a significant US market presence.
The discussions remain exploratory, and neither company has announced a definitive agreement or operational integration.

articles.title: CZ asks Musk to stop trolling, saying ‘our’ SpaceX shares top $1 billion
articles.text:
Quick Take
- CZ linked the claimed holding to a $500 million investment in Musk’s Twitter takeover.
- Yi He said annual revenue was sufficient to cover losses, leaving a SpaceX share sale unnecessary for now.
- Binance said it reserved over $6 billion in company funds, excluding frozen assets still awaiting recovery.
Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao asked Elon Musk to stop trolling during the exchange’s hack crisis on Oct. 30, citing SpaceX shares he valued at more than $1 billion as he appealed for support. Fellow co-founder Yi He subsequently said Binance did not yet need to sell those shares to cover the losses.
“Elon, have a lot of respect for you, but bad time to troll. Please stop,” Zhao wrote as @cz_binance, before asking Musk to show support.
Musk, posting as @elonmusk, had used a grimacing-face emoji earlier in the exchange.
Zhao called the holding “our SPCX shares,” linked it to a $500 million investment in Musk’s Twitter takeover and said it was worth more than a billion dollars. That ownership, valuation and investment connection remain Zhao’s account.
Yi He, posting as @heyibinance, said the company’s revenue for the year was sufficient to cover the losses, so it did “not yet need to sell” the SpaceX shares.
Zhao then explained his reference to the shares in a reply to her: he was showing Musk funds he might recognize so he could be less worried.
Binance later gave a separate funding update, saying it had reserved more than $6 billion of company funds to cover the incident.
In another post describing his “rough math,” Zhao weighed the hack losses against frozen assets, the Secure Asset Fund for Users, or SAFU, and the estimated SPCX holding. He described the remaining gap as painful but manageable.
Revenue over a year is different from funds available at a particular moment. An estimated equity value is different from cash, while frozen stolen assets still have to be recovered.
SpaceX shares and Binance’s funding commitment
In its later Oct. 30 funding statement, @binance said $5 billion of the company funds it had reserved was already held in the exact token assets affected. It said it was purchasing the remainder through market and over-the-counter channels.
Binance said that process could take longer because some tokens had low liquidity and over-the-counter settlement took time. The purchases were intended to match the affected token assets and address shortfalls, according to the company.
Binance expressly separated those figures from frozen or protected assets. It reported $3 billion frozen, while saying those assets remained subject to ongoing recovery and verification. That distinction keeps the company’s funding commitment separate from the outcome of efforts to retrieve stolen assets.
CryptoSlate’s earlier breach coverage reported that Binance had identified additional breach points and pledged to cover losses through SAFU and corporate resources.
For users assessing that assurance, Binance’s stated progress in obtaining the affected tokens is more directly relevant than the estimated value of the shares.

articles.title: Xe cộ luồn lách giữa công trường Vành đai 2,5 Hà Nội
articles.text:
TPO - Sau khi thông xe kỹ thuật, một số đoạn Vành đai 2,5 (Hà Nội) phục vụ lượng lớn phương tiện lưu thông dù công trường vẫn ngổn ngang. Nhiều nút giao thiếu đèn tín hiệu, mặt đường gồ ghề, máy móc thi công sát dòng xe, tiềm ẩn nguy cơ tai nạn giao thông.
TPO - Thành phố Hà Nội đang đẩy nhanh xây dựng nút giao Vành đai 4 sau khi lắp đặt dầm lớn, góp phần hoàn thiện mạng lưới giao thông khu vực Tây Nam.
TPO - Diễn biến thời tiết thực tế tại Hà Nội trong 24 giờ có mưa rải rác, nền nhiệt hạ cho cảm nhận mát mẻ. Ngày cuối tháng hình thái thời tiết khá dễ chịu, dự kiến trời nắng tăng nhiệt sớm trở lại khu vực.
TPO - Sáng 29/10, cầu Thăng Long chính thức thông xe sớm trước hẹn sau khi dỡ bỏ rào chắn đường bê tông xi măng, khôi phục luồng di chuyển thông suốt cho xe tải, xe khách và xe buýt.
TPO - Việc đưa cây xanh phủ dọc hầm chui và leo kín trụ cầu cạn đang mang lại diện mạo mềm mại, xanh mát cho các trục cửa ngõ Hà Nội.
TPO - HĐND thành phố Hà Nội thống nhất kéo dài thời gian kỳ họp để tiếp tục xem xét, thông qua Nghị quyết về việc thí điểm một số cơ chế, chính sách đặc thù để đầu tư xây dựng một số tuyến đường sắt đô thị trên địa bàn thành phố Hà Nội.
TPO - Trung tâm thương mại ngầm với quy mô 4 tầng hầm, tổng diện tích sàn khoảng 82.608 m² sẽ được xây dựng tại khu vực công viên, quảng trường phía Đông và phía Bắc hồ Hoàn Kiếm.
TPO - Theo UBND thành phố Hà Nội, việc điều chỉnh nhằm bảo đảm thống nhất quản lý nhà nước theo lãnh thổ với quản lý Vườn quốc gia Ba Vì; bảo vệ tài nguyên rừng, môi trường, tổ chức vùng đệm phù hợp với quy hoạch và bảo đảm quyền, lợi ích hợp pháp của nhân dân, tổ chức, doanh nghiệp.
TPO - Liên quan đến dự án tái thiết khu vực hồ Hoàn Kiếm và vùng phụ cận, với tổng mức đầu tư sơ bộ hơn 22.200 tỷ đồng, Ban Đô thị HĐND thành phố Hà Nội đề nghị làm rõ sức chịu tải tổng thể của khu vực, trong đó có tổng diện tích sàn xây dựng nổi và ngầm, chiều cao công trình, khối tích và mật độ các chức năng.
TPO - Sở Xây dựng Hà Nội vừa chính thức thông báo điều chỉnh tổ chức giao thông tại nút giao phía Bắc cầu Thăng Long, cho phép dỡ bỏ rào chắn từ 22h ngày 29/10, sớm hơn 12 ngày so với kế hoạch ban đầu.
Diễn đàn Khuyến nông năm 2026 với chủ đề “Liên kết sản xuất và tiêu thụ sản phẩm nông nghiệp” vừa được tổ chức tại xã Mê Linh, mở ra không gian kết nối thực chất giữa nhà quản lý, nhà khoa học, doanh nghiệp và nông dân nhằm ổn định đầu ra cho nông sản Thủ đô.
Trong 9 tháng đầu năm 2026, ngành Nông nghiệp và Môi trường Hà Nội đạt mức tăng trưởng 3,54%, duy trì sự ổn định ở các vùng sản xuất lương thực - thực phẩm tập trung, đồng thời đẩy mạnh số hóa dữ liệu quản lý tài nguyên và hoàn thiện chính sách phục vụ Luật Thủ đô.
Sở Nông nghiệp và Môi trường Hà Nội vừa triển khai thí điểm mô hình quản lý an toàn thực phẩm ứng dụng công nghệ số và camera AI tại hai vùng rau chuyên canh trọng điểm Bát Tràng và Mê Linh, nhằm tháo gỡ điểm nghẽn truy xuất nguồn gốc và kiểm soát rủi ro từ khâu canh tác.
Nhằm nâng cao chất lượng nông sản và bảo vệ quyền lợi người tiêu dùng, xã Bát Tràng (Hà Nội) đang triển khai đồng bộ các giải pháp quản lý từ đồng ruộng, chuẩn hóa quy trình canh tác và đẩy mạnh dán tem truy xuất nguồn gốc cho vùng rau an toàn tập trung.
TPO - Phó Chủ tịch Thường trực UBND TP Hà Nội Dương Đức Tuấn cho biết, thành phố sẽ xây dựng 12 phương án khắc phục hậu quả, tương ứng với 12 dự án của Mường Thanh.
TPO - Nói về kỳ họp thứ 7 của HĐND thành phố Hà Nội, Bí thư Thành ủy Hà Nội Trần Đức Thắng cho rằng “đây là một kỳ họp quan trọng có tính lịch sử vì sẽ xem xét quyết nghị thông qua những việc lớn, quan trọng của thành phố trong trước mắt cũng như lâu dài”.
TPO - Dự kiến gần 1.000 hộ dân lõi phố cổ Hoàn Kiếm (TP Hà Nội) được mua, thuê mua nhà ở xã hội không qua bốc thăm.

articles.title: Vinh danh các tác phẩm ảnh nghệ thuật 'Tự hào một dải biên cương'
articles.text:

articles.title: Nga cảnh báo mời Ba Lan vào G20 sẽ phản tác dụng
articles.text:
Trước đó, Ngoại trưởng Ba Lan Radoslaw Sikorski nói với báo chí tại Atlanta, rằng Mỹ đã nêu đề xuất để Ba Lan trở thành thành viên thường trực của G20, và Warsaw đang vận động cho mục tiêu này.
“Đương nhiên, điều này vi phạm nguyên tắc ngoại giao, đặc biệt là ngoại giao đa phương, khi các thành viên của những tổ chức như G20 hoạt động trên cơ sở đồng thuận”, hãng thông tấn Nga dẫn lời ông Lavrov phát biểu với báo chí, bên lề cuộc họp ngoại trưởng G20 tại Atlanta.
“Điều này liên quan đến chương trình nghị sự cũng như việc mở rộng lời mời tới các thành viên mới”, ông nói thêm.
Theo ông Lavrov, Ba Lan “không đóng góp thêm điều gì” cho cuộc họp, cho rằng Warsaw không đủ điều kiện tham dự cuộc họp vì quy mô nền kinh tế chưa đủ lớn.
Ngoài ra, theo nhà ngoại giao Nga, việc coi Ba Lan là đại diện cho “Đông Âu” cũng không chính xác, bởi NATO và Liên minh châu Âu (EU) đã có đại diện đầy đủ tại hội nghị.
Ông Lavrov cho biết Nga không chịu bất kỳ sức ép nào liên quan đến việc mời Ba Lan tham dự cuộc họp tại Atlanta.
“Người Mỹ đơn giản là đã mời ngoại trưởng Ba Lan. Ông ấy đến và ngồi vào chiếc ghế được bố trí cho mình”, ông Lavrov nói.
Trong phát biểu với báo chí, Ngoại trưởng Sikorski kêu gọi nhanh chóng thiết lập lệnh ngừng bắn tại Biển Đen, nhằm đảm bảo các chuyến vận chuyển ngũ cốc của cả Ukraine và Nga được lưu thông an toàn.
Quan hệ giữa Nga và Ba Lan hiện ở mức rất căng thẳng.
Ngày 29/10, báo Rzeczpospolita của Ba Lan đưa tin, các cuộc tấn công của Nga vào miền tây Ukraine đang làm tăng chi phí phòng không của Ba Lan, ngay cả khi không có máy bay không người lái hay tên lửa nào xâm phạm không phận nước này.
Tờ báo cho biết, Ba Lan đã triển khai máy bay quân sự thường xuyên hơn trong các đợt Nga tấn công miền tây Ukraine; nhiều nhiệm vụ trong số đó mang tính chất phòng ngừa và kết thúc mà không có bất kỳ hành vi vi phạm không phận Ba Lan nào xảy ra.
Trong những tuần gần đây, máy bay quân sự Ba Lan gần như hoạt động hằng ngày trên bầu trời đất nước trong bối cảnh Nga liên tục tấn công Ukraine, bao gồm các khu vực gần biên giới Ba Lan.
Tờ báo cho rằng việc triển khai liên tục này gây ra gánh nặng tài chính, lập luận rằng Mátxcơva có thể khiến Warsaw phải gánh chịu những khoản chi phí đáng kể mà không cần phải đưa vũ khí vào không phận Ba Lan.
Cũng theo tờ báo này, Ba Lan đang đầu tư vào các hệ thống radar bổ sung, hệ thống tác chiến điện tử, pháo phòng không và máy bay không người lái đánh chặn, nhưng mạng lưới này vẫn chưa hoàn thiện.
Các ngoại trưởng G20 lần này bỏ qua nghi thức chụp ảnh chung truyền thống trước thềm cuộc họp tại Atlanta, sau khi các đại diện châu Âu phản đối sự hiện diện của Nga.

articles.title: Nghệ An: Gỡ điểm nghẽn dự án tái định cư, sớm ổn định cuộc sống người dân vùng cao
articles.text:
Dự án chậm tiến độ, người dân chưa an cư
Đợt lũ lịch sử năm 2025, khiến 193 hộ dân xã Mỹ Lý mất nhà, phải di dời đến nơi ở khác. Để giúp người dân ổn định cuộc sống, tỉnh Nghệ An quyết định đầu tư 4 khu tái định cư tại các bản Cha Nga, Xằng Trên, Yên Hòa và Xiềng Tắm, với mục tiêu hoàn thành trước mùa mưa năm 2026.
Đợt lũ lịch sử năm 2025 cuốn trôi nhiều nhà cửa, tài sản của người dân xã Mỹ Lý (Nghệ An).
Tuy nhiên, theo báo cáo của UBND xã Mỹ Lý, đến cuối tháng 10/2026, tiến độ các khu tái định cư vẫn chưa đáp ứng yêu cầu.
Dự án tái định cư tại bản Xằng Trên, hiện công tác đào nền hoàn thành 80/82 lô, nhưng chỉ có 17 lô được san nền hoàn chỉnh để người dân dựng nhà. Các hạng mục thiết yếu đi kèm như kè chắn, thoát nước mưa, an toàn giao thông, cấp điện và nước sinh hoạt chưa được triển khai đồng bộ. Hiện nguồn vốn giải ngân của dự án đạt khoảng 14 tỷ đồng, tương đương 22,97%.
Tại bản Xiềng Tắm, dự án điều chỉnh từ 98 lô đất xuống còn 63 lô để tăng diện tích mỗi lô, loại bỏ vị trí nguy cơ sạt lở và điều chỉnh cao độ san nền nên đến nay tiến độ giải ngân chỉ đạt 28,85%.
Còn tại bản Yên Hòa, dù khối lượng đào đắp và san nền đã đạt trên 70%, dự án này vẫn chưa có quyết định phê duyệt. Hàng loạt nội dung trong hồ sơ thiết kế còn vướng mắc... Các hạng mục hạ tầng thiết yếu tại nhiều khu tái định cư chưa được triển khai đồng bộ.
Đáng chú ý, tại khu tái định cư Xiềng Tắm, phương án ban đầu dự kiến bố trí 98 hộ dân, nhưng sau 4 lần điều chỉnh thiết kế, số lô đủ điều kiện bố trí chỉ còn 63, giảm 35 lô. Việc điều chỉnh nhằm tăng diện tích đất ở, loại bỏ những vị trí có nguy cơ sạt lở, bảo đảm an toàn cho người dân khi chuyển đến nơi ở mới.
Tại bản Cha Nga, hơn 30 hộ dân vẫn phải sống trong những căn nhà tạm ven sông. Ở bản Xằng Trên, hơn 80 hộ dân đang mong chờ nơi ở mới dù khu tái định cư đã khởi công từ tháng 1/2026.
Anh Lương Văn Nhưn, trú bản Cha Nga, xã Mỹ Lý cho biết: Trận lũ năm 2025, gia đình chúng tôi chịu thiệt hại nặng nề, toàn bộ nhà cửa cùng tài sản tích cóp bị cuốn trôi hoàn toàn. Gia đình tôi đang phải ở trong căn nhà chật chội, dựng tạm ven sông, chờ ngày được chuyển đến nơi ở mới an toàn hơn.
"Hơn một năm qua, mùa mưa lũ thì dột nước, mùa nắng thì nóng kinh khủng. Vì thế, gia đình mong chính quyền các cấp quan tâm tạo điều kiện để người dân sớm có nơi ở mới ổn định", anh Nhưn nói.
Theo ông Lương Văn Bảy, Chủ tịch UBND xã Mỹ Lý (Nghệ An), do địa hình đồi núi phức tạp, khối lượng đá lớn và mưa kéo dài gây nhiều khó khăn cho thi công. Bên cạnh đó, những vướng mắc trong hoàn thiện hồ sơ, điều chỉnh thiết kế cũng ảnh hưởng đến tiến độ chung.
Khi các yếu tố kỹ thuật chưa được tính toán đầy đủ, phương án phải thay đổi trong quá trình thực hiện, khiến thi công gián đoạn, máy móc và nhân lực có thời điểm phải chờ đợi. Đây là điểm nghẽn cần được nhìn nhận rõ trong quá trình triển khai các dự án tái định cư tại xã Mỹ Lý.
Nhà thầu đang san nền dự án khu tái định cư tại xã Mỹ Lý. (Ảnh CSCC).
Theo ông Bảy, đến ngày 26/10, mặt bằng tại các khu tái định cư Yên Hòa và Xằng Trên gần hoàn tất. Các bên thống nhất phương án điều chỉnh thiết kế tại Cha Nga và Xiềng Tắm để tiếp tục triển khai các hạng mục còn lại.
Địa phương dự kiến tổ chức thi công cuốn chiếu, ưu tiên đường giao thông, điện, nước và các hạng mục thiết yếu, phấn đấu cơ bản hoàn thành trước ngày 30/11/2026.
"Để đạt mục tiêu này, các đơn vị cần tập trung xử lý dứt điểm vướng mắc về hồ sơ, thiết kế, đồng thời chủ động nhân lực, máy móc và phương án thi công phù hợp với điều kiện thời tiết miền núi. Những hạng mục đủ điều kiện cần triển khai ngay", ông Bảy nói.
Gỡ vướng, đẩy nhanh tiến độ tái định cư
Không chỉ tại Mỹ Lý, tình trạng thiếu vốn và dự án kéo dài nhiều năm cũng đang ảnh hưởng đến mục tiêu ổn định dân cư ở các địa bàn miền núi khác của tỉnh Nghệ An.
Theo báo cáo của UBND xã Châu Khê, dự án bố trí, sắp xếp dân cư vùng thiên tai, sạt lở và vùng đặc biệt khó khăn tại xã Lạng Khê cũ (nay là xã Châu Khê) được phê duyệt từ năm 2011, với tổng mức đầu tư hơn 63,5 tỷ đồng. Tuy nhiên, dự án đã dừng thi công từ năm 2014.
Đến nay, công trình mới được bố trí 18,2 tỷ đồng, còn thiếu hơn 45,3 tỷ đồng. Giá trị xây lắp đạt khoảng 41,88% khối lượng hợp đồng. Một số hạng mục còn dang dở như đường giao thông vào khu tái định cư, đường nội khu và hệ thống thoát nước. Các hạng mục nhà học mầm non, nhà văn hóa cộng đồng và hạ tầng điện chưa được triển khai.
Nguồn vốn Trung ương hỗ trợ mới đạt 18,2 tỷ đồng, tương đương khoảng 28,6% tổng mức đầu tư và đã được giải ngân hết. Phần vốn còn thiếu khoảng 45,377 tỷ đồng là nguyên nhân chính khiến dự án chưa thể tiếp tục triển khai đồng bộ.
Khu vực triển khai dự án bố trí, sắp xếp dân cư vùng thiên tai, sạt lở và vùng đặc biệt khó khăn tại xã Lạng Khê cũ (nay là xã Châu Khê).(Ảnh CSCC).
Ông Nguyễn Thế Mạnh, Chủ tịch UBND xã Châu Khê cho biết, qua rà soát, hiện có hơn 30 hộ dân có nhu cầu và đủ điều kiện được giao đất tái định cư. Trước thực trạng trên, địa phương kiến nghị cấp có thẩm quyền rà soát tổng thể dự án, xác định điểm dừng kỹ thuật để phân chia thành 2 giai đoạn đầu tư; đồng thời hướng dẫn điều chỉnh quy mô, tổng mức đầu tư và tiến độ thực hiện giai đoạn 2.
Theo ông Mạnh, đối với giai đoạn 1, địa phương đề nghị xem xét bố trí vốn để xử lý những tồn tại, hoàn thiện các hạng mục hạ tầng thiết yếu, đáp ứng nhu cầu tái định cư và bảo đảm hiệu quả sử dụng vốn đầu tư công.
Giai đoạn 2 sẽ được triển khai khi được cấp có thẩm quyền phê duyệt và bố trí nguồn vốn, tập trung vào các hạng mục giao thông, thoát nước, cấp nước sinh hoạt và hệ thống điện.
Việc phân kỳ đầu tư được địa phương đề xuất nhằm ưu tiên hoàn thiện những hạng mục cần thiết trước, tránh tiếp tục kéo dài tình trạng công trình dang dở trong khi người dân vẫn chưa có điều kiện chuyển đến nơi ở mới.
Dự án bố trí ổn định dân cư tập trung thôn Vĩnh Hoàn, xã Con Cuông đạt khối lượng xây lắp trên 80%, còn phần đường vào và cột điện đang gấp rút thi công, hiện có 5 hộ đang làm móng xây nhà ở. (Ảnh PT).
Tại xã Con Cuông, dự án bố trí ổn định dân cư tập trung thôn Vĩnh Hoàn đang được đẩy nhanh tiến độ và đạt khối lượng xây lắp trên 80%.
Theo ông Lương Quốc Hùng, Phó chủ tịch UBND xã Con Cuông (Nghệ An), dự án được triển khai từ tháng 7/2026 theo quy trình lệnh xây dựng khẩn cấp tại Quyết định số 3031/QĐ-UBND ngày 9/7/2026 của UBND tỉnh Nghệ An.
Đến nay, các hạng mục san nền, nền đường, hệ thống thoát nước sinh hoạt, thoát nước mưa và di dời đường dây điện 35kV, trạm biến áp đã hoàn thành. Tổng vốn bố trí cho dự án là 9,9 tỷ đồng, trong đó đã giải ngân 8,193 tỷ đồng, đạt khoảng 82,8%.
Về bố trí tái định cư, UBND xã đã giao đất đợt 1 cho 7 hộ dân, 5 hộ đang xây dựng nhà ở. UBND xã Con Cuông chỉ đạo các đơn vị liên quan tập trung nguồn lực, đẩy nhanh những hạng mục còn lại, phấn đấu hoàn thành dự án trước ngày 5/11/2026.
Ông Đặng Trọng Tấn, Giám đốc Công ty CP xây dựng Tấn Phong Phát, cho biết: Mưa lớn kéo dài đã ảnh hưởng đến điều kiện thi công và tiến độ một số hạng mục. Đến nay, còn hạng mục đường vào khu tái định cư và hệ thống cột điện vẫn đang thi công. Công ty huy động nhân lực, máy móc để đẩy nhanh tiến độ, nếu thời tiết nắng ráo sẽ hoàn thành công trình để phục vụ nhân dân theo kế hoạch đề ra.
Ngày 26/10, đoàn kiểm tra do ông Nguyễn Văn Đệ, Phó chủ tịch UBND tỉnh Nghệ An làm Trưởng đoàn đã đến kiểm tra tiến độ thi công dự án bố trí ổn định dân cư tập trung thôn Vĩnh Hoàn, xã Con Cuông. (Ảnh PT).
Tại buổi kiểm tra các công trình bố trí dân cư, tái định cư và các công trình chống sạt lở các xã vùng cao Nghệ An ngày 26/10, ông Nguyễn Văn Đệ, Phó chủ tịch UBND tỉnh Nghệ An đã yêu cầu các địa phương, đơn vị liên quan rà soát khó khăn, vướng mắc, xác định rõ trách nhiệm và đề xuất giải pháp tháo gỡ đối với từng công trình.
Đối với các dự án kéo dài nhiều năm, cần đánh giá cụ thể khối lượng đã thực hiện, nhu cầu vốn còn thiếu và hiệu quả đầu tư để lựa chọn phương án xử lý phù hợp, tránh thất thoát, lãng phí nguồn lực.
Ông Đệ yêu cầu các đơn vị, địa phương, ở khâu chuẩn bị đầu tư phải sát thực tế địa hình, dân cư và nguy cơ thiên tai, hồ sơ, thiết kế cần được phối hợp hoàn thiện từ sớm; nguồn vốn phải được tính toán phù hợp với khả năng hoàn thành dự án. Trong quá trình thực hiện, tiến độ từng hạng mục cần theo dõi thường xuyên, những vướng mắc phát sinh phải được xử lý kịp thời và trách nhiệm của từng đơn vị phải được xác định rõ.
Đối với các dự án đang triển khai, thường xuyên rà soát tiến độ từng hạng mục, xử lý kịp thời những vấn đề phát sinh, không để vướng mắc nhỏ kéo dài thành điểm nghẽn lớn. Những hạng mục đã đủ điều kiện cần tổ chức thi công ngay, ưu tiên hạ tầng thiết yếu để sớm đáp ứng nhu cầu, tạo điều kiện để người dân ổn định cuộc sống.
